## About Typeface

Typeface is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, United States. Founded in 2022, the company has 5 recorded locations across 2+ countries and employs approximately 275 people worldwide.

### Where is Typeface's main office?

Typeface's main headquarters office is located at 260 California Ave Ste 300, Palo Alto, California 94306, United States. This is the company's primary corporate address.

### Typeface regional offices

Beyond its headquarters in Palo Alto, Typeface has recorded locations in United States and Mexico.

### Typeface contact information

The main switchboard for Typeface headquarters can be reached at **+1 650 384 6565**. Official website: [typeface.ai](https://typeface.ai/).

### What does Typeface do?

Typeface is the generative AI application to supercharge personalized content creation for businesses. By uniting content velocity with brand personalization and control, any enterprise can now create exceptional, on-brand content faster and easier than ever before.

One entity, every stage
